strengths.why: Once latched it is hard to shake off, and the whole team can see the host.
The hover frame reaches vehicles quickly and slips away again.

weaknesses.why: It has to touch the vehicle, so it is exposed on the way in.
A light frame: once its charged shield is gone, one burst ends it.

countered_by.why: Sustained fire stops it before it reaches the hull.
A repair beam pulls it off the host.
EMP drops its shield and knocks it off.

counters.why: A tagged vehicle gets focused by the whole team.

counterplay: Shoot it on the way in: it is tiny and lightly protected.
Hold E to shake it off, or drive onto a repair pad.
Break line of sight from enemy launchers while you are tagged.

text.name: Rime Burr
text.pitch: A tiny Allied hover-drone that latches onto enemy vehicles, frosts them and paints them for the whole team.

signature.name: Frost Tag
signature.effect: Latch onto a vehicle: while attached, the host is slowed and visible to your team through walls.

team_play_hook.text: Tag the tank, and your rocket teammates lock on to it.

how_it_plays.as_user: Skim in fast, pounce on a vehicle and ride it while your team focuses it. Hop off before the crew shakes you loose, or freeze infantry that come to help.
how_it_plays.as_target: A pale glint lands on your hull and your vehicle shows up for the enemy. Hold E to shake it off, drive to a repair pad, or get out of the launchers' sight.
how_it_plays.teammates: Rocket and missile players get free locks on the tagged vehicle; a repair player is the host's best friend.

controls.action: Cryo beam: slows infantry and vehicles

how_it_plays.tells: A pale blue glint and crackle on the hull, and a frost icon over the tagged vehicle that everyone can see.
